title: Teamleiter Immobilienverwaltung (m/w/d)
description:
ÜBER BUENA

Buena baut die Technologie, auf der die Immobilienbranche läuft. Wir machen jeden Teil der Immobilienwirtschaft so nahtlos und transparent wie möglich, vom Finden über das Finanzieren bis zum Verwalten.

Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und bauen sie zu Technologieunternehmen um. In den letzten drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 30 Leuten im HQ zu Deutschlands zweitgrößtem Immobilienverwalter geworden.

ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Du kennst den Alltag einer Hausverwaltung und weißt, wie du Ordnung reinbringst, wenn Abläufe stocken, Aufgaben liegen bleiben oder Verantwortlichkeiten unklar sind.

Genau dort setzt du bei Buena an. Jeden Monat übernehmen wir neue Hausverwaltungen, und du überführst sie in den Buena-Betrieb. Deine Basis ist unser Büro in Berlin, deine Einsätze finden in unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland statt. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich in funktionierenden Abläufen und in Teams, die mit der Buena App besser arbeiten als vorher.

VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN

- Du arbeitest im Tagesgeschäft unserer Verwaltungen mit, erkennst Engpässe früh und baust Rückstände ab. Vor und nach der Umstellung auf die Buena App.

- Du schaffst mit den Teams klare Zuständigkeiten und Prozesse, die auch nach deinem Einsatz Bestand haben.

- Du kennst unsere Software in- und auswendig und trainierst die Teams an ihren konkreten Aufgaben.

- Du bringst deine Erfahrungen aus dem Verwaltungsalltag zurück ins Product-Team. Was du vor Ort siehst, macht unsere App besser.

DU PASST GUT, WENN DU

- Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Immobilienverwaltung mitbringst und das Tagesgeschäft eigenständig beherrschst.

- Probleme schnell erkennst, Prioritäten setzt und selbst mit anpackst.

- Klar kommunizierst, schnell Vertrauen aufbaust und Menschen für neue Arbeitsweisen gewinnst.

- Tech-affin bist. Neue Software lernst du schnell und erklärst sie so, dass anderen die Arbeit leichter fällt.

- Bereit bist, regelmäßig bei unseren Verwaltungen in ganz Deutschland vor Ort zu arbeiten, je nach Einsatz auch mehrere Tage am Stück.

- Fließend Deutsch sprichst.

DEINE BENEFITS

- Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus, wenn du 10 bis 20 Gehminuten vom Büro entfernt wohnst.

- 110 €/Monat Lunch-Budget, 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss.

- 1.200 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget.

- Kostenlose Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest.

WARUM JETZT EINSTEIGEN

- Du bist die Person vor Ort: Jede Verwaltung, die wir übernehmen, wird erst durch dich zu einem Buena-Betrieb. Ohne dich bleibt sie, was sie war.

- Wir wachsen schnell: Jeden Monat kommen neue Hausverwaltungen dazu. Deine Einsätze werden nicht weniger, sondern größer.

- Wir sind meritokratisch: Wer liefert, bekommt Verantwortung. Unser CEO war vor drei Jahren Junior Product Manager, unser COO vor zwei Jahren Chief of Staff.

- Wir verändern eine ganze Branche: Die deutsche Hausverwaltung läuft noch auf Papier und Excel. Du stellst das vor Ort um.

Today someone pieces them together by hand, whether that’s an adjuster scoping storm damage or a contractor quoting a homeowner’s remodel. Hover already holds the property data that connects them. We’re rebuilding this team around this role, so the architecture, the engineering bar, and the shape of the team are yours to influence.

title: Senior Azure Architect – MIM Modernization & Microsoft Entra ID
description:
Senior Azure Architect - MIM Modernization & Microsoft Entra ID

Industry: IT Services

Salary: ₹₹24 LPA

Experience: 10+ years

Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Azure Architect to lead the strategic modernization of our Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM) infrastructure and drive the adoption of Microsoft Entra ID. In this pivotal role, you will design and implement robust, scalable identity solutions that enhance security and operational efficiency across our cloud ecosystem. This position demands a deep understanding of hybrid identity environments, where you will bridge legacy systems with modern cloud-native architectures. Your expertise will be instrumental in orchestrating complex migrations, automating identity workflows, and ensuring seamless integration between on-premises directories and cloud services, ultimately securing our digital perimeter while enabling a frictionless user experience.

Responsibilities

• Architect and execute the modernization roadmap for Microsoft Identity Manager, transitioning from legacy on-premises models to cloud-centric identity frameworks.

• Design and deploy secure identity synchronization solutions utilizing Entra Connect and Entra Cloud Sync to maintain data consistency across hybrid environments.

• Develop and manage serverless automation workflows using Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Azure Automation to streamline identity lifecycle processes.

• Engineer custom integrations and extensions leveraging Microsoft Graph API, REST APIs, and JSON protocols to enable advanced application connectivity.

• Maintain and optimize hybrid directory services, including Active Directory, AD LDS, and Exchange Online, ensuring high availability and performance.

• Implement robust security postures by configuring Azure Key Vault for secret management and utilizing Azure Monitor and Microsoft Sentinel for proactive threat detection and response.

• Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) initiatives using Bicep, ARM templates, and Terraform to ensure reproducible, version-controlled infrastructure deployments.

• Create and maintain complex PowerShell scripts for Entra ID administration, enabling sophisticated automation and governance capabilities.

• Provide architectural guidance on Azure infrastructure design to support identity and access management (IAM) requirements.

Requirements

Requirements:

• Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in IT services, with a significant focus on Azure cloud architecture and identity management.

• Proven expertise in Microsoft Entra Connect and Entra Cloud Sync configuration and troubleshooting.

• Advanced proficiency in developing and managing Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Azure Automation runbooks.

• Strong command of Microsoft Graph API, RESTful web services, and JSON data handling for custom integrations.

• Deep knowledge of Active Directory ecosystems, including AD LDS and Exchange Online administration.

• Hands-on experience with Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, and Microsoft Sentinel for security and observability.

• Demonstrated ability to implement Infrastructure as Code using Bicep, ARM, or Terraform.

• Specialized experience in Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM), including scripting, customization, and modernization strategies.

• Extensive background in PowerShell scripting specifically for Microsoft Entra ID automation and management.

• Comprehensive understanding of Azure Architecture principles and best practices for enterprise-scale deployments.

title: Institutional Partnership & B2B Sales (Medical Doctor - MD) - Mexico/Latam
description:
About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we've grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town.

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video https://youtu.be/gTPDn5XpeJg to explore what makes us unique.

WHY CAN THIS POSITION BE EXCITING FOR YOU?

We are now expanding our institutional partnerships across Latin America, and we are looking for someone to lead that growth with universities, hospitals and clinics in the region.

You will own a territory of medical schools and healthcare institutions in Latin America, being responsible for turning enthusiasm for AMBOSS into institutional partnerships. This is a consultative, relationship-driven B2B sales role: you will identify the right institutions, understand what their faculty and deans actually need, show how AMBOSS can address it, and guide each partnership from first conversation to signed agreement and successful launch.

For this opportunity, you are required to be a licensed medical doctor in a Latin American country, and while having previous commercial or sales experience is a plus, the personality and attitude comes first.

What matters most is your drive and ability to build trust and long-term relationships with physicians and academic leaders; run a structured sales process and closing.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Build the territory plan. Map universities and hospitals in LATAM that do not yet offer AMBOSS to their students or staff, prioritise them with your team, and work the pipeline systematically.

- Open doors and run discovery. Engage active student users, faculty champions and decision-makers (deans, academic directors, heads of education), and run needs analyses to understand their goals, exam results, curriculum and budget realities.

- Present and persuade. Create and deliver tailored presentations and demos that connect AMBOSS to each institution’s specific priorities, and handle objections with confidence.

- Close and launch. Lead negotiations through to signed agreements, then hand over cleanly to Customer Success so that implementation and roll-out are a success.

- Grow accounts with data. Work with our Data and Sales Operations teams to analyse usage data, prove impact to partners, and identify expansion opportunities.

- Be the voice of the region. Act as the interface between institutions and our Customer Success, Sales Operations, Product and Marketing teams, and bring market insight back to the company.

- Represent AMBOSS. Plan campus events and projects, attend conferences, and actively network to build brand awareness in the region.

WHAT YOU BRING:

(засоби живлення і стабільний інтернет забезпечуєш самостійно)

Wellbeing програма: для всіх співробітників доступні медичне страхування з першого робочого дня; консультації психолога, нутриціолога чи юриста; дисконт програми на спорт та покупки; family days для дітей та дорослих; масаж в офісі.

•
Крута команда: наші колеги - це спільнота, де вітаються допитливість, талант та інновації. Ми підтримуємо один одного, вчимося разом та зростаємо. Ти можеш знайти однодумців у понад 15-ти професійних ком’юніті, читацькому чи спортивному клубах.

•
Кар'єрні можливості: ми заохочуємо просування всередині банку між функціями.

Програма підтримки захисників і захисниць: ми зберігаємо робочі місця та виплачуємо середню заробітну плату мобілізованим. Для ветеранів та ветеранок у нас діє програма підтримки, розвивається ветеранська спільнота Банку. description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

THE ROLE

You'll lead marketing operations and analytics at Cohere. That covers the team, the martech stack, how we measure marketing's contribution to pipeline, and the budget and pipeline numbers marketing plans against. When leadership asks what marketing produced last quarter and what to fund next, the answer starts with your numbers.

The role reports to the VP of Brand. You'll work most closely with the Marketing Chief of Staff and the heads of Growth and Demand and Product Marketing, and every week with Revenue Operations, Sales Operations & Finance. Web operations is part of marketing but doesn't report to this role.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

THE TEAM

You'll manage the marketing operations, automation, and analytics and data operations staff, and hire where you find gaps. Marketing is growing rapidly, so you'll also bring acquired companies' systems and data into our stack.

MEASUREMENT

The attribution methodology is yours, documented and signed off by Marketing, Revenue Operations and Finance. Each quarter you'll present marketing's pipeline contribution to the executive team and say what you'd change. Your analysts do the same for the program teams in Growth and Demand, Events and Product Marketing, showing which campaigns and channels are paying back their spend.

SYSTEMS AND DATA

Marketo, Looker, GA4 and 6sense are yours end to end, along with the campaign and lead side of Salesforce. That includes forms, nurture, lead lifecycle, scoring and routing. Campaign data needs to be structured well enough that analysts don't need workarounds, and target-account data has to reconcile to the governed account list. With Revenue Operations, you'll make sure the data behind marketing's pipeline numbers can't change without a record, so a bulk edit can't quietly rewrite marketing's results. A/B testing on nurture and forms sits with you too, sized so the results can be read.

Over time we want fewer tools and fewer dashboards, with one governed source for each metric.

BUDGET AND PLANNING NUMBERS

You'll own the martech and operations budget and track budget and headcount across marketing. You'll also build the pipeline and capacity models marketing plans against. The Marketing Chief of Staff runs planning and the business reviews and leads the trade-off conversations with your numbers in hand. Marketing and Sales need to count pipeline the same way, every time.

YOUR FIRST YEAR

In the first 90 days, you'll document the attribution methodology and get it signed off by Marketing, Revenue Operations and Finance. By then we should also have an inventory of every reporting surface, each with a named owner, and your order for fixing the data problems you inherit.

By three months, one governed executive dashboard has replaced the competing decks in business reviews, and rebuilt lead routing is in production.

The role involves preparing complex financial models and presentations for senior leadership, managing multiple business initiatives, and fostering team development through coaching and mentoring. Upholding the highest standards of integrity and compliance, the Senior Manager ensures alignment with company values and contributes to continuous improvement and operational excellence.
About the team:
The Finance team plays a pivotal role in driving financial planning, forecasting, and analysis to support business decisions. This team collaborates across functions to ensure accurate balance sheet management, cash flow forecasting, and financial performance evaluation. Members leverage strong technical accounting expertise and advanced financial modeling skills to analyze results, explain variances, and communicate insights to leadership. The team is committed to enhancing forecasting processes, mitigating financial risks, and delivering actionable recommendations that align with organizational goals. Effective communication and cross-functional partnership are key to the team’s success in supporting strategic financial management.
What you'll do:

• Prepare and analyze complex financial models to support planning and recommend future expense targets.

• Manage control structures to mitigate financial risks and ensure accuracy in reporting and compliance.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and enhance financial processes and reporting transparency.

• Communicate financial results, forecasts, and variances to senior management with clear presentations and documentation.

• Lead execution of business plans by identifying needs, setting priorities, and adjusting performance to meet objectives.

• Supervise and develop associates through coaching, mentoring, and performance management.

• Promote adherence to company policies, ethics, and integrity standards across teams.

What you'll bring:

• Extensive experience in financial planning, analysis, and modeling to support business performance and decision-making.

• Proven ability to manage complex control structures and mitigate financial risks through effective oversight and process improvements.

• Strong leadership skills with a track record of mentoring, developing, and evaluating team members to build high-performing teams.

• Excellent communication skills to present financial results, forecasts, and recommendations to senior management and cross-functional partners.

• Demonstrated commitment to ethics, integrity, and compliance with company policies and regulatory standards.

• Ability to drive business plans, remove obstacles, and adapt strategies to meet evolving operational needs.

We are looking for a detail-oriented Revenue Contract Review Specialist to support contract review and revenue recognition in accordance with ASC 606 (US GAAP). This role will focus on reviewing customer contracts, identifying revenue implications, and ensuring accurate and compliant revenue treatment.
The Order-to-Cash (O2C) team is responsible for supporting Saviynt 's revenue operations by ensuring customer contracts are accurately translated into sales orders, invoices, collections, and financial reporting. The team partners closely with Sales, Deal Desk, Revenue Accounting, Customer Success, and Finance to drive operational excellence, support scalable growth, and maintain strong financial controls across the customer lifecycle.
WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

● Review customer contracts, order forms, amendments, and renewals to assess revenue recognition implications under ASC 606.

● Analyze key contract terms including performance obligations, pricing, billing structures, variable consideration, termination rights, and payment terms.

● Identify revenue risks and non-standard terms that may impact revenue recognition, allocation, or reporting.

● Ensure compliance with ASC 606 and internal revenue recognition policies.

● Provide accounting guidance and document conclusions for complex and non-standard contract arrangements.

● Evaluate revenue treatment for contract modifications, renewals, terminations, refunds, and multi-element arrangements.

● Support SSP reviews, transaction price allocation, and revenue schedule validation.

● Prepare and maintain audit-ready revenue memos and supporting documentation.

● Partner with Deal Desk, Legal, Sales, and Finance teams to review contract structures and drive appropriate revenue outcomes.

● Support internal and external audit requests related to contract review and revenue recognition.

● Assist with month-end close activities, revenue reporting reviews, reconciliations, and variance analysis.

● Identify opportunities to strengthen revenue processes, controls, documentation, and automation.

WHAT YOU BRING

● 3-6 years of experience in Revenue Accounting, Technical Accounting, or a similar role.

● Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.

● Strong knowledge of ASC 606 (US GAAP) and revenue recognition principles.

● Experience reviewing contracts and interpreting commercial terms.

● Experience in SaaS, subscription-based, or technology-driven business models.

● Familiarity with ERP systems, preferably NetSuite.

● Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.

● Ability to communicate accounting conclusions clearly and effectively to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.

> Mobile Device Policy

> Personnel Security Policy
> Privacy Policy

title: Senior Modem SOC Design Engineer - TeraWave
description:
Application close date:
Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed. At Blue Origin , we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 
Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations. As a Senior Modem SOC Design Engineer on the ASIC Engineering SOC Team, you will design digital hardware for the TeraWave satellite communication System on Chip (SOC). You will own RTL design for modem datapath and PHY blocks, implement signal processing hardware, and build out the Arm compute subsystem, debug, and IO infrastructure that surround it. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You will work from communication system specifications through microarchitecture, RTL, SOC integration, and timing closure, partnering with architecture, verification, and physical design teams to deliver production silicon.

Responsibilities

• Design RTL in Verilog or System Verilog for modem datapath and PHY blocks

• Define microarchitecture from satellite communication system specifications and performance requirements

• Implement signal processing hardware including filters, FFT, equalizers, and forward error correction

• Develop Arm compute subsystem logic including AXI interconnect and SRAM controller integration

• Integrate debug subsystem components using Arm CoreSight architecture and associated trace infrastructure

• Design general purpose IO subsystem logic and associated configuration register interfaces

• Integrate subsystem and SOC level blocks including clock and reset architecture

• Support synthesis, timing constraint development, and timing closure with physical design teams

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field

• Minimum 5 years of experience in digital ASIC or SOC RTL design

• Experience with RTL design in Verilog or System Verilog for modem or PHY blocks

• Experience with Arm compute subsystem design including AXI interconnect and SRAM controllers

• Experience implementing signal processing hardware such as filters, FFT, or forward error correction

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field

• Experience with debug subsystem design using Arm CoreSight components

• Experience defining microarchitecture from communication system and algorithm specifications

• Experience with SOC level integration including bus fabric, clock, and reset architecture

• Experience with synthesis, timing constraint development, and timing closure support

• Experience with LPDDR6 or other high speed memory interface subsystems

• Experience with gigabit Ethernet or 25G high speed serial interface subsystems

CA applicants is $230,398.00 - $322,556.85WA applicants is $230,398.00 - $322,556.85 Other site ranges may differ

You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
